prompt:
A single emblem for the back of every card in Mythologica, a card game of world mythologies: painted in gold leaf and bronze on a fully transparent background, rustic 1990s hand-painted style, worn, bold simple silhouette, symmetrical and centred. No text, no letters, no numbers, no circle or badge behind it.

Subject: An ouroboros: a serpent biting its own tail, forming a ring around a small flame.
